featuredProjects.title: MetaTenant BaaS
featuredProjects.description: A centralized Backend-as-a-Service architecture for multi-tenant SaaS applications. It delivers strict database isolation, dynamic schema compilation, and a high-performance REST API from a single Django codebase.

otherProjects.title: Web Novel EPUB Compiler
otherProjects.description: A Python utility that bypasses Cloudflare protections to asynchronously scrape serialized novels from the web. It parses the raw HTML and automatically compiles the text into cleanly formatted EPUB files for offline reading.
